verdict.rationale: Jira's feature docs describe progress-reporting capabilities: burn-down charts and engineering cycle time measurement, visibility into progress toward top priorities, and progress views (boards, lists, timeline, calendars). Community users also praise JQL and REST queries for slicing project data. However, nothing in the pack mentions configurable dashboards or widgets themselves, so the specific story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of customizable dashboards, widget/gadget building and configuration, sharing dashboards with stakeholders, and independent hands-on corroboration of dashboard reporting.
